opportunities.title: Measurement & Data Scientist – survey design, statistics and AI-assisted analysis (contract, remote)
opportunities.description: About W4Helix W4Helix is an independent advisory firm. We help organizations understand how their people actually work with AI and what it is worth to the business. We sell no software, licences or training, so our findings have to stand on evidence alone. We are interviewing prospective freelancers for a long-term contract role. You will build the measurement and analysis behind our client work. You will not need to speak with clients. What you will do - Design questionnaires and assessments that are valid, reliable and short enough that people finish them - Plan samples and produce results with honest margins of error - Clean and combine data from several sources, including exports from business software - Build repeatable analysis pipelines, including AI-assisted analysis of open-text responses, and prove they are accurate - Turn results into clear tables and charts a non-technical executive can read in two minutes - Document every step so another analyst could reproduce your results exactly Critical skills - Survey methodology or psychometrics: scale design, reliability and validity testing; item response theory or Rasch modelling a strong plus - Applied statistics: sampling design, confidence intervals, estimating from a sample to a whole population - Python or R for data cleaning, analysis and automation (pandas, tidyverse or similar) - Hands-on experience using large language models to code or classify text, and checking that work against human judgment - Comfortable with messy real-world data from spreadsheets and business-software exports - Clear written English for reports and documentation The person we want - Rigorous and sceptical: you check your own numbers before anyone else does - Honest about uncertainty: you would rather report a range than a flattering single number - Discreet: you handle confidential organizational data with care, always - Independent and organized: you work well remotely and meet agreed deadlines - Able to overlap a few hours a week with US Eastern time for a short call Background that fits - A master's or doctorate in statistics, psychometrics, education research, psychology, economics, public policy or a related field; or equivalent professional experience - Research or analytics work in education, workforce, HR or organizational settings is a plus Practical details - Contract, remote; paid per project or hourly, agreed in advance - Confidentiality agreement required before any client or method materials are shared - Paid trial first: a small fixed-price task using made-up data - Start: as client engagements are confirmed To apply, answer: 1. Describe one survey or assessment you designed or validated. How did you show it was reliable, and what did you change as a result? 2. Describe a time you used an AI model to classify or code text. How did you check its accuracy, and what did you find? 3. A client says "our staff save 5 hours a week." What would you want to know before you believed it? opportunities.title: Sparkling Title, Transitions, Credits
opportunities.description: I already have the main edit locked; I now need a finishing touch. Your job is to open the piece with a title that materializes slowly, carrying a very subtle sparkle—just enough to catch the eye without feeling flashy. I will provide several short video transition clips that should be woven in smoothly at the points marked on my timeline, keeping pacing and color consistency intact. Once the content wraps, create a clean credits page that matches the look of the opener (same typography, gentle sparkle hint) and lists the names I’ll supply. Deliver the final render in the original resolution plus the editable project file (Premiere Pro or After Effects preferred) so I can tweak minor details later if needed. If this sounds straightforward to you, let’s get started—I’ll supply the media and timing notes as soon as we agree.

opportunities.title: Quick Hindi Text Entry
opportunities.description: I need help typing a short batch of Hindi text data. The task is small—roughly an hour of focused work—so accuracy and speed matter more than elaborate setup. You will receive all the source material in a single go; your job is simply to key it in exactly as provided, preserve paragraph breaks, and return the finished file to me the same day. Because the content is text-only, no numeric tables or calculations are involved. I am flexible on the final file type (Word, Excel, or Google Docs all work), as long as the characters render correctly in Unicode and there are no stray formatting codes or extra spaces. Before we start, I’ll send you a short sample so you can confirm the font displays correctly on your side. Once you deliver the completed file, I’ll run a quick spot-check for typos. If everything matches the source, we’re done—simple and straightforward.

opportunities.title: Correct CAD Alignment & Errors
opportunities.description: I already have a complete CAD model, but a few nagging errors are keeping it from moving to production. The file shows several parts sitting slightly off-center and a couple of angles that drift from the intended specs. On top of that, the brand logo is sitting in the wrong spot and needs to snap back to its proper location. Here’s what I need from you: • Realign every mis-positioned part so all mating surfaces meet cleanly and the assembly zeroes out without clashes. • Correct the inaccurate angles so they match the original design intent (I’ll provide the reference image). • Update the logo with different font • Return a clean, fully-constrained CAD file (same format I provide—most likely .stp file) plus a quick screenshot or PDF showing the corrected views for visual confirmation. No new components, no dimensional changes—just repair the existing geometry. If you can turn this around quickly in AutoCAD, SolidWorks, or a comparable package and send back a file that opens error-free, we’re good to go.

opportunities.title: Manual Mobile App QA Tester Needed
opportunities.description: # iOS & Android Mobile App QA Tester – Human Testing Only – Ongoing Projects We are a Canadian software development company looking for an experienced mobile app QA tester for ongoing projects. We will begin with one paid trial application. **Freelancers are invited to submit their competitive fixed-price bids.** ### Important: 100% Human Testing Required **All testing must be performed manually by a real human tester using physical iOS and Android devices.** - No AI-generated testing or AI-assisted testing. - No AI agents, bots, or automated testing tools. - No AI-generated bug reports or testing summaries. - No simulated test results. - All screens, workflows, buttons, and features must be personally tested by the assigned freelancer. - Screenshots and recordings must come from actual testing sessions. We require genuine human observations, including usability feedback from a real user's perspective. ### Scope of Testing - Test all major screens, buttons, and navigation. - Verify core features and user workflows. - Identify crashes, functional bugs, and unexpected behaviour. - Check UI/UX, readability, layout, and usability. - Test form validation, error handling, and common edge cases. - Test on physical iPhone and Android devices. - Identify confusing or frustrating user experiences. ### Required Deliverables 1. Manual test checklist showing Pass/Fail/Blocked. 2. Detailed bug report with steps to reproduce. 3. Actual screenshots or screen recordings. 4. Device models and OS versions. 5. Personal usability observations and recommendations. 6. Final human-written testing summary. ### Requirements - Previous experience with manual mobile app QA. - Access to physical iPhone and Android devices. - Strong attention to detail and clear communication. - No subcontracting without prior approval. ### How to Apply Please provide: 1. Your fixed-price bid for testing one app on both platforms. 2. Devices and OS versions available. 3. Sample manual bug report. 4. Estimated completion time. 5. Confirmation that **all testing and reporting will be performed personally, without AI or automation**. Successful testers may receive additional ongoing projects.

opportunities.title: CSV-to-Excel Data Reformat
opportunities.description: I need help moving numeric data that currently lives in a CSV file into a brand-new Excel workbook laid out exactly the way I want it. Even though the source is a single CSV, it represents multiple logical “sheets” of relational information, so simple copy-and-paste won’t work. Here’s what I’m after: • Import the CSV cleanly, preserving every value and its relationships. • Reshape the data into a custom structure I will provide (think separate tabs, look-up tables, and summary pivots rather than a mirror of the original). • Deliver a finished .xlsx file plus a short note—or a recorded macro/VBA script if that speeds future updates—showing how you achieved the transformation. Accuracy is critical: totals must match the source, references between tables need to stay intact, and the final workbook should open with no broken formulas or external links. If you’re comfortable with Power Query, VBA, or similar Excel automation tools, that’s a bonus, but plain formulas are fine as long as the result is rock-solid.

opportunities.title: Graduation Photography Booking Platform Development
opportunities.description: Project Title: Build a School Graduation Photography Booking Platform for H Studio Project Description: I’m looking for an experienced web developer to design and build a booking platform for school graduation photography. The platform should make reservations clear and easy to manage for our staff, photographers, students, and families. We already have a desktop HTML prototype that demonstrates approximately 99% of the intended workflows and visual structure. All data in the prototype is simulated, and no database is connected. You will use this HTML as the starting point for the final platform’s design and functionality. Core Features - Responsive website that works smoothly on desktop, tablet, and mobile. - Administrative dashboard for managing bookings and users. - Role-based access with different permissions for administrators and photographers. - Booking history with filters by date, classroom, or activity. - Databases and backend functionality for all forms and workflows. - Automated notifications and messages through WhatsApp Business and email. - Integration of externally hosted photography galleries, each with a unique link and password for the student or family. - Local photo storage for a portfolio showcasing additional services, such as First Communion photography and events. - A structure that supports basic payment gateway integration in the future, if required. What We Will Provide - The desktop HTML prototype, including simulated data and detailed workflow examples. - An Excel database of public and private schools. - A dedicated WhatsApp Business number for H Studio. - A domain registered with GoDaddy. - An external photography gallery provider that generates unique gallery links and passwords. - Legal text for the privacy policy and related pages. What You Will Deliver - A fully functional platform based on the supplied HTML prototype. - A clean, modern design aligned with H Studio’s visual identity, with tasteful animations and intuitive navigation. - The databases, forms, user permissions, and booking workflows needed to operate the system. - Automated messaging configured through the appropriate WhatsApp Business and email integrations. - Secure handling of authentication, access tokens, personal data, and private gallery details. - Improved operational logic and polished interface text where needed. - End-to-end testing and validation of all agreed functionality. - Deployment on the agreed hosting environment and connection to our domain. Some features still need to be defined or developed in more detail. We expect the selected developer to review the prototype, identify gaps, and help clarify these before implementation. Please Include in Your Proposal - Examples of booking platforms or similar systems you have built. - Your recommended technology stack and hosting approach. - Your estimated timeline and budget. - Any questions, assumptions, or third-party costs, including WhatsApp messaging, email delivery, hosting, and storage. We are looking for someone who can turn the existing prototype into a reliable, secure, and easy-to-use platform.

opportunities.title: Pelo humano realista en Blender
opportunities.description: Trabajo con Blender 4.4 y necesito que un artista 3D me prepare un sistema de peluquería realista para un personaje humano. Busco un look de cabello largo y lacio, con un acabado creíble tanto en vistas de tiempo real como en render final. (Tsunade - Naruto) Alcance esperado • Crear el groom completo dentro de Blender 4.4 usando los nuevos Hair Assets / Geometry Nodes. • Configurar materiales y shaders para que el cabello responda correctamente a luz y sombra (Cycles y Eevee). • Entregar el archivo .blend limpio, organizado por colecciones y con los modifiers no aplicados, para que yo pueda ajustar densidad o estilo si lo necesito. • Incluir una breve guía en texto o video (máx. 5 min) que explique cómo mover el cuero cabelludo, actualizar el corte y variar su longitud sin perder la forma base. Requisitos – Debe mantenerse la sensación de caída propia del cabello lacio. – Evitar clipping con la geometría del cuerpo y respetar el volumen natural en reposo. – El proyecto debe abrirse sin errores en la versión 4.4 estable. Se valorará experiencia previa en groom realista y conocimiento de herramientas como Comb, Puff y Sculpt Curves dentro de Blender. Adjunta ejemplos o un breve reel que muestre trabajos similares.

opportunities.title: Interactive 3D Anatomy App
opportunities.description: I want to bring a fully interactive 3D skeleton to iOS and Android so users can spin, zoom, and tap any bone or muscle for instant, targeted information. When a body part is selected the app should present three clear paths: • Medical terminology and clinically accurate details about the structure. • A concise AI-generated summary of common pain sources in that region. • Evidence-based strengthening or stretching guidance — shown through either realtime 3D animations or smooth video playback, whichever best suits the workflow you recommend. The browsing experience needs to feel effortless: touch-driven selection, optional search, and a minimal UI that never hides the model. I’m open to Unity, Unreal Engine, or a robust native 3D framework as long as performance on recent iOS and Android devices stays above 60 fps. For this first milestone I’m looking for: 1. A working skeleton prototype with accurate muscle overlays. 2. Tap-to-info panels populated with placeholder text pulled from a simple JSON or lightweight backend. 3. One sample exercise and stretch presented in your chosen 3D or video format so we can validate the media pipeline. Code must be clean, documented, and ready for later integration with external health-service APIs. If this sounds like your specialty, tell me how you would handle the real-time rendering, content management, and cross-platform deployment, and include links to any similar visual-or medical-centric apps you’ve shipped.

opportunities.title: Founding Operations Manager – Build and Manage Offshore Back-Office Services Team
opportunities.description: Long-Term Opportunity | Remote | Contract / Part-Time Initially About the Opportunity I am launching a U.S.-based managed business services company providing outsourced back-office operations to small and midsize businesses throughout the United States. Our planned services include bookkeeping support, accounts payable and receivable, invoicing, billing administration, payroll coordination, general administration, CRM support, and business process automation. I am seeking an experienced Back-Office Operations Manager who can help establish and eventually lead our offshore service delivery operation. This is not a typical virtual assistant position. I am looking for someone with management experience who can help build a professional, scalable business. The right candidate could grow into a long-term leadership position as the company expands. Key Responsibilities Phase 1 – Business Setup and Planning Help define the services we can reliably deliver. Recommend staffing requirements and appropriate contractor rates. Develop standard operating procedures and quality-control processes. Recommend software and workflow management tools. Help establish client onboarding procedures. Develop a scalable offshore delivery structure. Phase 2 – Team Recruitment Identify and evaluate qualified bookkeeping, AP/AR, billing, and administrative specialists. Interview prospective contractors. Recommend candidates, compensation, and staffing arrangements. Coordinate paid skills assessments. Build a reliable team of professionals, subject to company owner approval. Phase 3 – Client Service Delivery Manage assigned client workflows and deadlines. Supervise offshore specialists. Monitor work quality and productivity. Coordinate client onboarding and service transitions. Maintain professional client communications. Develop performance reports and operating metrics. Improve efficiency through standardized processes and automation. Required Qualifications At least five years of relevant back-office, BPO, or outsourced business operations experience. Demonstrated experience managing remote teams. Experience supporting U.S.-based business clients. Strong understanding of bookkeeping, AP/AR, invoicing, and business administration. Familiarity with QuickBooks Online and common U.S. business software. Excellent written and spoken English. Experience developing SOPs, managing deadlines, and monitoring quality. Ability to recruit, train, and supervise additional offshore professionals. Strong organizational and problem-solving skills. Experience with AI automation, Zapier, Make, CRM systems, or workflow automation is highly desirable. Working Arrangement This is initially a part-time, project-based independent contractor opportunity. We are currently establishing the business and validating customer demand. There is no guaranteed immediate full-time workload. The selected candidate will initially participate in a paid planning and evaluation project. Additional responsibilities and compensation will increase as customer contracts are secured. We are interested in developing a long-term relationship with someone who wants to help build and lead a growing operation. Compensation Please provide your hourly rate in USD. We are considering qualified candidates primarily in the Philippines, although experienced applicants from other countries are welcome. Application Instructions Please answer the following questions: How many years have you managed outsourced back-office operations for U.S. businesses? How many remote employees or contractors have you directly supervised? Which services have your teams delivered? What accounting, CRM, and workflow software have you used? Have you recruited and trained offshore professionals? How would you organize service delivery for five U.S. business clients? How do you ensure accuracy, confidentiality, and consistent client service? What is your hourly rate and current availability? Are you interested in helping build a company from its earliest stage? Please describe one specific example of an outsourced operations team you helped build or manage. Generic proposals will not be considered. We are looking for a potential long-term operations leader, not simply someone to complete administrative tasks.

opportunities.title: Hyper-Local Lead Generation Campaign
opportunities.description: I run a specialist waterproofing firm in Visakhapatnam and I’m ready to scale our inbound pipeline. The single metric that matters is qualified leads; every activity below ladders up to that outcome. Here’s the growth stack I need built and managed: • Google Business Profile – Rank for high-intent, location-rich terms such as “PU grouting Vizag”, “expansion joint leakage Vizag” – Publish one geotagged site-photo post each week to feed local signals • Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram) – my preferred lead engine – Hyper-local campaigns targeting apartment associations and warehouse owners inside city limits – Creative offer: “Free Site Inspection” with instant lead forms – Continuous split-testing of copy, creative, audiences, and call routing • Google Search Ads – Bid only on emergency, bottom-funnel keywords (“emergency basement waterproofing”, etc.) – Tight ad groups, ad extensions, and call-only variants for after-hours enquiries • LinkedIn B2B Outreach – Direct connections and drip messages to civil engineers, plant managers, and PMCs along Vizag’s industrial corridor • WhatsApp Business Automation – Set up catalog-enabled profile with quick-reply quote templates – Embed downloadable company credentials for instant trust • Social Proof Content – Weekly 20-second reels showing live leak arresting / chemical injection work, posted to Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts Acceptance criteria 1. Minimum 25 qualified inbound enquiries in the first 30 days, traceable via UTM and CRM tags. 2. Google Business Profile clicks and calls increase by at least 40 % month-over-month. 3. All paid channels maintain CPL under the agreed threshold (to be set after initial audit). Access to current ad accounts, GBP, and on-site footage will be provided on award. Let’s turn local intent into daily project bookings.

opportunities.title: Modern Front Yard Landscape Redesign
opportunities.description: My front yard needs a fresh, modern look built around sweeping curves, a statement tree in the centre, and a series of raised garden beds packed with low-maintenance plants. I’d like a cohesive concept that balances clean, contemporary lines with soft planting pockets so the space feels welcoming yet remains effortless to keep tidy all year. Scope of work • Concept plan illustrating the new layout, curved pathways and bed shapes. • Planting scheme focused on drought-tolerant, low-maintenance varieties—please note any seasonal interest or textural contrasts you include. • Construction details for the raised garden beds: recommended materials, dimensions, and a simple step-by-step so a local contractor can follow easily. • Placement guidance for a single feature tree at the centre, including ideal species options and root-zone considerations. • Optional but appreciated: 3D or sketch visualisations to help me picture the finished design. Acceptance criteria 1. All drawings supplied in PDF (and source files if created in SketchUp, AutoCAD, Revit, or similar). 2. Plant list with common & botanical names, mature sizes, and care notes. 3. Clear indications of hardscape vs. softscape areas with measurements. 4. Final package delivered ready for submission to my installer without further revision. If any site measurements or photos are required, let me know and I’ll provide them right away.

opportunities.title: PocketOption autotrading Bot
opportunities.description: I need a fully-automated binary-options bot that connects directly to PocketOption and trades a pure mean-reversion strategy without manual input. The program has to watch live market data continuously, detect when price drifts far enough from its statistical mean, open the corresponding CALL or PUT, then manage and close the position according to parameters I can adjust (expiry time, stake size, profit-target, stop-loss, maximum simultaneous trades, cool-down). Core requirements • Real-time monitoring, signal generation, order placement, and order closing must all happen inside the bot. • It should authenticate with my PocketOption account through the official API or a reliable web-automation workaround if the API is restricted. • Strategy variables (look-back window, deviation threshold, Martingale on/off, etc.) need to be editable in a simple JSON or GUI panel so I can tweak without touching code. • Logging of every action—timestamp, price, trade direction, outcome—into a CSV or database for later review. • Error handling that pauses trading and alerts me if connectivity or balance issues arise. Deliverables 1. Source code and a runnable build. 2. A short README covering setup, configuration, and how to run it 24/7 on Windows or Linux. 3. A quick video or screenshots proving the bot opening and closing at least one trade on a live or demo PocketOption account. Acceptance criteria The program must be able to run unattended for at least one full session, place trades solely from the mean-reversion logic, and close them automatically while respecting the adjustable risk limits specified above.

opportunities.title: Twitch Drops duplication: they patched our method, a competitor still runs it. Rebuild it — paid only on a verified in-game result.
opportunities.description: 1. The system, mechanically Twitch runs a drops service. A campaign owns reward groups (each one is a drop with a requiredMinutesWatched). Each reward group points at a benefit — the actual item. Watching accrues minutes per reward group; when minutes ≥ requirement the claim button unlocks. Claiming is one GraphQL call: mutation DropsPage_ClaimDropRewards(input: ClaimDropRewardsInput!) { claimDropRewards(input: input) { status error { code } } } ClaimDropRewardsInput has exactly ONE field: dropInstanceID dropInstanceID = " # # " I verified by probing the live type definition that there is no quantity, count, amount, repeat or multiplier field — the mutation accepts one string and nothing else. Two different identities sit under that one call, and this is the whole story: insert key = (user, reward_group_id) ← what the claim writes against ledger key = (user, benefit_id) ← what actually shows in your inventory The refusal message proves the insert key verbatim: requesting_user_id 917697569 has not earned reward_group_id 0f95100a-…. The inventory node id proves the ledger key: 9620a89d-…_CUSTOM_ID_2110811 — organisation prefix plus benefit custom id. 2. How the pre-patch method worked The delivery row was keyed with a session component. Claim once, present N sessions, get N delivery rows for the same benefit — one click, many items. That is the entire duplication: not a race, not a bypass, just a key that contained something the client could vary. 3. How they patched it The session component was removed. Key became (user, reward_group_id). Consequences, all measured: 11 sequential claims of one instance → one award, error: null each time 40 pre-warmed TLS sockets released from a single barrier, 1.66 ms spread → 40 × ELIGIBLE_FOR_ALL, one award fresh Client-Session-Id, fresh X-Device-Id, fresh OAuth token, full re-login → one award 25 structural mutations of the instance string (uppercase, BOM, leading/trailing whitespace, extra # segments, foreign uid, urn:uuid:, no-dash) → server trims, resolves the same object, or returns a silent null. proposal.subject: Propuesta Directa: Twitch Drops duplication: they patched our method, a competitor still runs it. Rebuild it — paid only on a verified in-game result.
proposal.body:
¡Hola Solicitante Anuncio #40776538 (Bots, WhatsApp & Automatización)! 👋 Revisé la solicitud exacta de **"Twitch Drops duplication: they patched our method, a competitor still runs it. Rebuild it — paid only on a verified in-game result."** y cumplo con los requisitos para iniciar de inmediato.

Realizo **bioconstrucción en guadua, muro tendinoso con botellas y vidrio, todo tipo de cubiertas y estructuras en metal/soldadura, secaderos de café, murales artísticos, modelado 3D en Blender y planos**.

📲 Contacto directo en San Agustín, Huila (Colombia): **+57 322 273 9034**.
proposal.turnaround: 24 a 48 horas

blueprint.target_audience: Maestros de obra, remodeladores, carpinterías, fabricantes de cocinas integrales e inmobiliarias en Colombia (Instagram y Facebook).
blueprint.suggested_pricing: COP $220.000 a $650.000 por proyecto (Pago por Nequi / Bancolombia: 50% al iniciar, 50% al entregar).
blueprint.distribution_channels: Escribir por WhatsApp o Instagram DM a 10 cuentas de remodelaciones/cocinas en Colombia cada día ofreciendo el servicio por proyecto.

opportunities.title: Local Business Developer for Machinery Spares
opportunities.description: We are a professional supplier based in China, specializing in aftermarket spare parts for construction machinery. Our product portfolio covers excavator spare parts for Komatsu, CAT (Caterpillar), Sany, XCMG, LiuGong and other mainstream heavy equipment brands. We are now looking for local freelance business developers located in **Asia and the Middle East**, to help us identify, contact and onboard local wholesalers & distributors of construction machinery spare parts. ### Your Responsibilities 1. Research and identify qualified local wholesalers, distributors and trading companies that sell excavator aftermarket parts in your region (Asia / Middle East). 2. Initiate contact with decision-makers, introduce our company and product range. 3. Collect valid business information of target wholesalers: company profile, contact person, email, WhatsApp, business scope, purchasing volume and procurement requirements. 4. Set up initial business discussions and facilitate communication between our Chinese team and local buyers. 5. Follow up with potential distributors until we reach cooperation agreements. ### Payment Terms (Flexible, you can choose) **Commission basis**: Commission paid upon successfully closed orders **Hourly rate**: Hourly payment for research, lead generation and communication work **Fixed project fee**: One-time lump payment for completed lead list and qualified distributor connections ### Our Requirements for Freelancer 1. You are currently residing in Asia or the Middle East, with existing local network in construction machinery / heavy equipment spare parts industry preferred. 2. Fluent in local language and English; able to communicate with local wholesale dealers smoothly. 3. Experienced in B2B lead generation, business development or procurement sourcing. 4. Able to verify the authenticity of distributors and confirm they have actual purchasing demand for Chinese excavator spare parts. ### What We Provide - Full product catalog, price list and product technical specifications - Company introduction document, product photos and marketing materials - Professional technical & sales support from our China team during negotiations If you have existing contacts of machinery parts wholesalers in your local market, please send your proposal and briefly introduce your market resources and experience.

opportunities.title: FiveM Enhanced MLO/YMAP Developer — Conversion, Conflict Resolution, Consolidation and In-Game Testing
opportunities.description: Fixed total budget: USD 500 for the agreed full scope, not per group. We need an experienced FiveM mapping developer to prepare our existing YMAPs and associated assets for FiveM Enhanced. This project covers existing map files and their required models, textures, collisions, archetypes, occlusion and LOD data. It does not involve general framework development, gameplay systems or creating new interiors from scratch. You must already have a working GTA V Enhanced installation, FiveM Enhanced test environment, CodeWalker and the required conversion tools before accepting. Required work 1. Convert assets for FiveM Enhanced - Convert applicable Legacy models and textures using FiveM Alchemist or an appropriate verified workflow. - Preserve the required YMAP, YTYP, collision and other supporting map data. - Verify that the resulting assets load correctly in FiveM Enhanced. - Report conversion failures or unavailable source files promptly. Conversion logs or a folder named stream_enhanced alone do not establish completion. 2. Merge and organize map resources Consolidate the supplied maps and assets into: - ns-businessmaps - ns-shadowmaps - ns-governmentmaps - ns-housingmaps - ns-jobmaps - ns-leisuremaps - ns-worldmaps - ns-mapdata for agreed shared mapdata and compatibility files. The target is one working map resource per category, with a correct top-level manifest, required registrations and an organized streaming structure. Identify any technical or asset-protection restriction before proceeding. Do not simply move unchanged individual resource folders under a category folder and describe them as merged. 3. Resolve map and asset conflicts Identify and resolve: - Duplicate filenames with different contents. - Conflicting map definitions and archetypes. - Overlapping placements and map edits. - Collision, occlusion, LOD and streaming conflicts. - Conflicts between category groups and shared mapdata. Removing duplicate filenames is not necessarily conflict resolution. Preserve the required changes from each affected map. Do not select a conflicting version solely by alphabetical order, load order or file size. Document the resolution and validate it in game. Do not remove maps, replace businesses or choose between overlapping alternatives without our approval. 4. Repair and optimize Within the agreed asset inventory: - Fix missing models, props and textures. - Address texture loss, flickering, incorrect collisions and visibility issues. - Review and repair LODs, draw distances, map bounds and lighting where needed. - Optimize textures and models where justified, preserving acceptable visual quality. - Clean unnecessary files from the delivery. - Verify compatibility when all supplied groups run together. Any required UK-style texture or signage changes must be listed against specific assets before the fixed scope is agreed. In-game validation is mandatory Before submitting a category as completed: - Load it on a working FiveM Enhanced test server. - Visit every included map location. - Check models, textures, collisions, lighting and visibility. - Inspect repaired areas from different distances and angles. - Check relevant server/client errors and streaming warnings. - Test it with its required map dependencies. Before final delivery, test all completed categories together. For performance claims, provide before-and-after measurements using the same hardware, settings, locations and conditions. CodeWalker inspection, automated reports and videos of files opening are not substitutes for FiveM Enhanced testing. AI and automation may assist the work, but the developer remains responsible for inspecting and validating the results. Scope and delivery We will agree a dated inventory of included maps/assets, required repairs, exclusions and delivery dates before implementation. We may initially share only a small batch for qualification. Further groups follow after that batch is validated. The initial batch does not redefine the full-project budget. Work document: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1flO2glbX3TW3HPoyxrFSscfGvPfFdJvmt8ExuxPz6NI/edit?gid=860763218 Each delivery must include: - One ZIP containing complete installation-ready resource folders. - Correct manifests and required map files. - Installation instructions, dependencies and start order. - A file-level change list and conflict-resolution record. - A per-location test checklist with relevant in-game screenshots or recordings. - A clear list of any unresolved issues. Blocked or untested work must be identified as incomplete. Do not silently delete assets or return an untested pack as finished work. General server/framework development and unrelated scripts are outside scope. Existing asset dependencies must be identified and preserved; any required script changes must be raised before implementation. Your proposal must confirm 1. Your experience with FiveM Enhanced YMAPs and associated assets. 2. That your game, tools and test environment are already operational. 3. How you resolve conflicting collision and occlusion files. 4. How you verify conversion and test every supplied map location. 5. Your delivery schedule for the qualification batch, remaining groups and final combined test. 6. That you have reviewed the inventory and can complete the agreed scope for USD 500, with any exclusions stated before acceptance. Relevant experience and verifiable results are required. Generic bids will not be considered.

opportunities.title: Spanish Subtitles for Blog Videos
opportunities.description: I’m finishing the last step of a large video push for our blog and need the cut-scenes and narrative-style segments subtitled in Spanish. The raw footage is already rendered to MP4 and runs well past the one-hour mark in total, yet everything outside those story segments—menus, UI, bumpers—has been handled elsewhere, so you can ignore them completely. I’ve prepared clean, time-coded English transcriptions for every scene you’ll touch. Your job is to translate those lines into natural-sounding Spanish and sync them perfectly to picture. I’m happy with standard subtitle files (.srt or .ass), but if you prefer burning them directly into the MP4, let me know; I can provide the source files. Feel free to work in Subtitle Edit, Aegisub, Premiere, or any tool you trust, so long as the final captions render correctly when I test them in VLC and YouTube Studio. Deliverables • Spanish subtitle file for each video (matching original filename) • Proofed timing with no line overruns or orphan frames • A quick read-me noting any tricky cultural references you adapted Once I drop the download link, you’ll see a folder numbered in sequence; return the finished subs in the same structure so I can publish without relinking anything. Carefully review the attachment for more details

El estilo visual debe ser ágil; la información de la propiedad (metros, ubicación, precio o llamada a la acción) puede aparecer mediante texto sobreimpreso siempre que mantenga el ritmo fluido. Entrego: • Carpeta con todas las fotos seleccionadas. • Texto clave y datos destacados de la vivienda. • Logotipo de la agencia (si fuera necesario integrarlo). Espero recibir: • Video final en formato horizontal Full HD (y, si es posible, una versión corta cuadrada para redes sociales). • Corrección de color básica para que las imágenes luzcan uniformes. • Música libre de derechos alineada con el tono solicitado. • Archivo editable o proyecto fuente para ajustes futuros. Si prefieres añadir efectos adicionales —por ejemplo, gráficos o diagramas de distribución— estoy abierto a sugerencias siempre que mantengamos la estética fresca y dinámica. *incluir toma imagen aerea desde google maps *idioma español de preferecncia

opportunities.title: Professional Saree E-Commerce Website -- 2
opportunities.description: Hi, I am looking for a freelancer to develop a beautiful, professional, and mobile-friendly e-commerce website for my saree business. My budget for this project is ₹2,000. Required Features Home Page: Attractive design with a saree collection banner and featured products. Product Upload: I should be able to easily add, upload, edit, and delete saree photos, prices, descriptions, and product details. Product Categories: Organize sarees by type, design, occasion, and price. Size and Details: Customers should be able to view saree measurements, blouse-piece availability, fabric, color, and other product details. If sizes or variants are applicable, customers should be able to select them. Shopping Cart: Customers should be able to add sarees to their cart and review their orders. Buy Now Option: Customers should be able to place orders easily. Order and Contact Options: WhatsApp ordering or a simple order/enquiry system. Mobile-Friendly Design: The website must work smoothly on mobile phones, tablets, and computers. Admin Access: I need an easy way to upload new sarees and update prices without contacting the developer every time. Website Hosting: I want the website to be live so I can share the link with customers and they can visit and shop. Important Requirements The design should look premium, elegant, and suitable for a saree brand. I will provide the product photos and business details. Please explain which features you can deliver within my ₹2,000 budget. Mention whether hosting, domain, payment gateway integration, and maintenance are included or charged separately. Please share examples of your previous e-commerce websites. I am looking for a reliable freelancer who can deliver a working website, not just a design or HTML demo. Please share your approach, delivery timeline, and final price before starting the project.

opportunities.title: AutoCAD Gym Wall Layout Modeling
opportunities.description: I need a clean AutoCAD file that lets me visualise my gym wall from three fixed perspectives—side, bird’s-eye, and a seated living-room viewpoint. For each angle I want to toggle the wall-mounted folding rack between open and closed so I can judge clearance and aesthetics in both states. Keep the geometry to basic shapes and structures; I don’t need textures or photorealism. What matters is dimensional accuracy. I’ll supply the exact wall span plus measurements for the folding rack, weights bar, weight stand, hyper-extension bench (which hangs on the wall) and a flat bench. Please build these items as separate blocks so I can drag them around and test different layouts until everything fits. An interactive model is essential. A simple DWG with view presets or a lightweight AutoCAD viewer file that lets me orbit, pan and switch layers will do the job. Alongside that, include 2D elevations/plans aligned to the three views so I can print quick reference sheets. Acceptance: • All equipment placed to scale and on its own layer or block. • Three named views saved (Side, Top, Living Room) plus rack-open / rack-closed states. • File opens in vanilla AutoCAD 2021+ without missing references. Once I confirm clearances and flow, the project is done.

opportunities.title: Homeseer HS4 TouchDesigner Troubleshooting
opportunities.description: I'm seeking assistance with Homeseer HS4 TouchDesigner. The issue involves a garage door setup where the HS4 Touch Designer button is not updating its text to reflect the garage door's status (Open, Closed, or In-Transit) based on the virtual device values. Details: - The garage door has devices indicating closed and open states. - A virtual device tracks the position with values: 0 (Closed), 1 (In-Transit), and 2 (Open). - Events execute for transitions between these states. - The Designer button should display "Open," "Closed," or "In-Transit" but is not functioning as expected. The ideal freelancer should have: - Experience with Homeseer HS4 and TouchDesigner - Strong problem-solving skills - Ability to troubleshoot and fix integration issues - Familiarity with device status updates and automation systems Your expertise will help ensure my home automation runs smoothly. Please provide relevant experience in your bids.

opportunities.title: Agente Atención Cliente WhatsApp 24/7
opportunities.description: Busco un agente dedicado que gestione la atención al cliente por WhatsApp de nuestro negocio. Qué espero: • Cubrir un servicio 24/7, rotando turnos según convenga, para que ningún mensaje quede sin respuesta. • Atender entre 50 y 200 consultas diarias, manteniendo tiempos de respuesta ágiles y tono cordial. • Registrar cada interacción en nuestro panel CRM (o en una hoja de seguimiento si no tuvieras CRM propio) y escalar los casos complejos a mi equipo interno. • Resolver dudas frecuentes, informar sobre estado de pedidos y políticas, y capturar feedback. Requisitos clave: – Excelente redacción en español y habilidad para empatizar con el cliente. – Experiencia previa usando WhatsApp Business, etiquetas y respuestas rápidas. – Conexión estable y disponibilidad real para cubrir fines de semana y noches. Entregables: 1. Respuestas en tiempo real dentro del horario acordado. 2. Reporte diario con métricas de conversaciones atendidas, tiempos de respuesta y casos escalados. 3. Propuestas de mejora continua basadas en preguntas repetitivas o puntos de fricción detectados. Si ya has trabajado como agente multicanal o manejas integraciones con herramientas como Zendesk, HubSpot o Freshdesk, menciónalo: será un plus. Espero tu propuesta con una breve descripción de tu experiencia y tu disponibilidad horaria exacta.

opportunities.title: Realistic 3D Model Creation
opportunities.description: I need a skilled 3D modeler who can take my reference material and turn it into a clean, production-ready model. The job is geometry-only—no textures, rigging, or animation at this stage—so your focus should be on accurate proportions, efficient topology, and proper scene organisation. Once we begin I will provide reference images, key dimensions, and any technical constraints; you will translate those into a watertight asset and deliver it back in standard formats such as .fbx and .obj (plus the native file from your preferred tool—Blender, Maya, 3ds Max, or similar). When you apply, please highlight your relevant experience with comparable modelling projects. That’s all I need to see to decide quickly. Acceptance criteria: • Clean, non-destructive modelling workflow with tidy naming conventions • Quad-dominant topology suitable for future editing or subdivision • Final files delivered in .fbx, .obj, and the original working file Looking forward to seeing how your experience can bring this model to life.

I’ll share that file with you as soon as we start; your task is to match it as closely as possible inside Blender, recreating the same sequence with Roblox-style rigs and simple props. What matters most is fidelity to the reference: timing, poses, and overall flow should feel almost identical. If you see small opportunities to tidy up clipping or smooth a transition, go ahead, but keep the final look recognisably the same. Please work in Blender so I can open the .blend if I ever need tweaks. When you’re done, I’ll need: • The final rendered video (1080p, 30 fps is fine) • The complete .blend file with all assets linked or packed I’m happy to review playblasts or low-res previews first, then one revision pass once the full render is ready. If this run goes well, I have more Roblox shorts lined up, so clear, commented Blender files and organised timelines will be appreciated.

The whole experience has to feel premium, so the UI/UX must shine on mobile, tablet, and desktop, complete with smooth micro-animations, intuitive navigation, and lightning-fast load times. Design direction Think modern: a balanced colour palette, crisp typography, high-quality visuals, and subtle interactive touches that reinforce a professional brand image while keeping the focus on conversion. Scope and process You’ll handle everything from wireframes and mock-ups to final deployment on my hosting. I’ll supply product copy and assets; you deliver a turnkey store ready to sell on day one. Timeframe and any milestone plan you prefer. Quality work, clear communication, and a smooth handover are top priorities for me. If you can craft an experience that feels as good as it looks, let’s talk and get this store live.

opportunities.title: Print-On-Demand Shopify Store Launch Specialist
opportunities.description: # Hiring: Print-on-Demand Brand Launch Expert | Niche Research + Shopify + Growth Strategy ## Project Overview I am looking for an experienced Print-on-Demand (POD) e-commerce specialist to help me build and launch a premium, conversion-focused Shopify brand from scratch. I have already purchased a domain, created my Shopify account, and integrated Razorpay. However, I have not yet finalized a niche. My goal is to identify a promising niche through research, develop a differentiated brand, create an initial collection of approximately 40–50 original designs, and launch a professionally designed Shopify store within **4–5 days**. I want to build a genuine, scalable brand with the potential to generate ₹1 lakh or more in monthly revenue over time. I understand that results depend on product-market fit, execution, and customer acquisition, and I am not looking for unrealistic guarantees. ## Scope of Work ### 1. Niche Research and Validation Help me shortlist 3–5 promising POD niches, focusing initially on the Indian market while considering international opportunities where relevant. Research should cover: * Target audience, customer behaviour, and buying motivations. * Competitor analysis, pricing, positioning, and customer reviews. * Demand signals from search trends, marketplaces, and social media. * Market gaps and differentiation opportunities. * Product pricing, estimated margins, competition, and advertising challenges. * Trademark and copyright risks. **Deliverable:** A research-backed comparison of shortlisted niches and a clear recommendation on which niche to launch first, supported by evidence rather than assumptions. I do not want generic niche suggestions without a clear target audience and a compelling reason customers would buy. ### 2. Brand Strategy and Identity Develop a cohesive brand that looks premium and trustworthy, including: * Brand positioning and unique value proposition. * Target customer persona. * Brand name suggestions, if required. * Logo direction, typography, colour palette, and visual identity. * Brand voice and differentiation strategy. * Initial product pricing and bundling recommendations. ### 3. Product Collection: 40–50 Designs Help create approximately 40–50 original designs aligned with the selected niche. Deliverables include: * Product and collection strategy. * Original, commercially usable designs. * High-quality product mockups. * Print-ready files and specifications. * Product titles, descriptions, and size information. * Recommendations for hero products to feature at launch. Please clarify whether you create the designs yourself or use a separate designer. All designs must be original or properly licensed, with commercial usage rights transferred to me. ### 4. Shopify Store Development Build a clean, premium, mobile-first Shopify store using my existing account and domain. The store should include: * Premium homepage and clear navigation. * Product collections and conversion-focused product pages. * High-quality mockups and consistent branding. * Cart, checkout, and Razorpay payment testing. * Integration with a suitable POD supplier. * Shipping, returns, privacy, terms, and contact pages. * FAQs, size guides, and relevant trust elements. * Basic SEO, analytics, and conversion tracking. * Mobile responsiveness, performance checks, and test orders. The store should be ready for real customers, with a documented order fulfilment process. ### 5. Supplier Selection and Unit Economics Recommend a reliable POD supplier based on product quality, printing costs, shipping, delivery timelines, returns, and Shopify integration. Prepare a simple unit economics sheet showing: * Selling price and product/printing cost. * Shipping and applicable transaction fees. * Estimated contribution per order before and after advertising costs. * Break-even customer acquisition cost. * Expected margins based on clearly stated assumptions. ### 6. Growth Funnel and Marketing Plan Develop a practical launch and customer acquisition strategy covering: * Instagram and short-form video content. * Organic marketing and creator collaborations. * Meta Ads testing strategy, if appropriate. * Product-page and checkout conversion optimization. * Abandoned-cart recovery and customer retention. * Email or WhatsApp marketing with appropriate customer consent. * Key metrics: conversion rate, average order value, acquisition cost, and contribution margin. Provide a realistic **30-day post-launch growth plan** with experiments, priorities, and measurable outcomes. ### 7. Final Deliverables * Research report and recommended niche. * Brand identity and editable assets. * 40–50 agreed designs and product mockups. * Functional Shopify store under my ownership. * Configured product catalogue and POD integration. * Unit economics spreadsheet. * Analytics and tracking setup. * Launch checklist and 30-day marketing plan. * Handover walkthrough and documentation. Please disclose all additional costs, including paid themes, apps, subscriptions, and supplier charges. ## Timeline My target is to launch within 4–5 calendar days. Please propose a realistic day-by-day execution plan, identifying what can be completed in parallel and any dependencies. Quality and commercial viability matter more than simply uploading 50 products. If necessary, propose launching the strongest products first while completing the remaining collection. ## Ideal Freelancer I am looking for someone with proven hands-on experience in: * Shopify store development. * Print-on-demand operations. * Niche and competitor research. * E-commerce branding and merchandising. * Conversion optimization and growth marketing. Preference will be given to candidates who have launched real POD or DTC brands and can demonstrate their contribution with live stores or case studies. ## Questions to Answer in Your Proposal 1. Share 2–3 relevant Shopify/POD stores you personally worked on and explain your role. 2. How would you identify and validate a niche when I have no niche preference? 3. opportunities.title: Premium Hindi Dhoop Ad Video
opportunities.description: For my incense brand, Devkund Dhoop, I need a polished 15–20 second vertical video (9:16) that will run as an Instagram Reel and Facebook Ad. The visual mood should feel premium—warm brown-gold tones, slow-motion shots of Gomay Dhoop cones gently burning, and clear, well-lit packaging reveals that highlight texture and detail. Audio: • Male Hindi voice-over that sounds trustworthy and grounded • Soft, soothing background music mixed under the narration (no copyright issues) Key story beats I imagine: 1. Establish the calming ritual—close-up of the cone igniting, delicate smoke swirling. 2. Show the branded pack in focus, accented by the brown-gold palette. 3. Voice-over communicates purity of gomay dhoop and invites viewers to place an order. 4. Clear on-screen CTA with my preferred contact or website line at the end. Deliverables I must receive: • Final 9:16 MP4 ready for paid ads, colour-graded in the described palette • One compressed version (<2 MB) for quick sharing • Separate clean audio stem of the VO+music mix • Ownership confirmation for unlimited commercial use • Absolutely no watermark Before I release any milestone, please send either a quick 3–5 second sample using stock or a direct link to a similar reel from your portfolio so I can gauge style and audio quality. Kindly confirm in your bid: • All-inclusive price (taxes/fees covered) within my ₹500 budget • How many revisions you will provide at no extra cost • Turnaround time from script approval to final render • Written assurance that I can use the video for commercial advertising Looking forward to seeing how you can make Devkund Dhoop stand out in just a few captivating seconds.

opportunities.title: Fractional LinkedIn Ads Strategist – B2B Lead Gen & Campaign Automation
opportunities.description: Here is a project description tailored for hiring platforms like MarketerHire, Upwork, or marketing candidate dashboards. Job Posting / Project Brief Title: Fractional LinkedIn Ads Strategist – B2B Lead Gen & Campaign Automation Company: International Greenscapes Role Type: Fractional / Part-Time Consultant Project Scope: Small-budget test phase with view to scale Project Overview International Greenscapes is looking for an experienced B2B LinkedIn Ads Strategist to help us design, launch, and optimize a focused lead generation program. We are starting with a lean initial budget ($1,500 – $3,000/month in ad spend) to validate our targeting, messaging, and cost-per-lead (CPL) metrics before scaling up. We plan to utilize campaign automation and reporting platforms (e.g., Adhook) alongside CRM integration to keep management efficient and data-driven. Key Responsibilities ⚬ Strategy & Setup: Define micro-targeted B2B audiences (ICPs), draft high-converting ad hooks, and set up native LinkedIn Lead Gen Forms. ⚬ Tool Integration & Rules: Configure automation workflows and IF/THEN budget safety rules in Adhook (or similar tools) to pause underperforming ads and protect spend. ⚬ Funnel Optimization: Ensure seamless lead flow from LinkedIn into our CRM for rapid sales follow-up. ⚬ Performance Advisory: Lead bi-weekly strategic check-ins to review campaign metrics, refine ad copy/creative, and advise on budget scaling once target CPLs are achieved. Required Experience & Qualifications ⚬ Proven track record running successful B2B LinkedIn Lead Generation campaigns. ⚬ Experience running small-budget test campaigns effectively without burning spend during learning phases. ⚬ Familiarity with campaign management software, automation tools (like Adhook), and CRM integrations (HubSpot, Salesforce, etc.). ⚬ Deep understanding of B2B pipeline metrics—focusing on Cost Per Qualified Lead (CPQL) rather than just clicks or impressions. How to Apply When submitting your proposal, please include: 1. A short summary of your experience running B2B LinkedIn Lead Gen campaigns. 2. Examples or case studies showing how you optimized small-budget tests ($1.5k–$3k/mo). 3. Your hourly or fractional monthly retainer rate. - The project will initially be in a per hour basis for the planning stage and will move to a fixed monthly fee

opportunities.title: 1990's FiveM Roleplay Discord Server Promotion
opportunities.description: Grow 90's-Era FiveM Roleplay Discord Server (Beta Launch Nov 6) Budget: $100–500 USD, paid on delivery Project description: 90's Los Santos Roleplay is a serious, slow-burn FiveM RP server set in 1996+ Los Santos. Beta opens Friday, November 6. We're whitelist-only and need genuine FiveM / GTA RP players — no bots, no spam — through safe, legitimate promotion that spotlights the server: 90's-era Los Santos, serious slow-burn roleplay, whitelist applications opening soon. The push should centre on GTA RP forums, FiveM server-listing Discords, Reddit/server showcase threads where allowed, and established gaming-community Discord servers where serious role-players already gather. If other social channels organically support these efforts that's welcome, but the core outreach must stay where the RP crowd is. Deliverables I expect: • A concise promotion plan outlining servers/forums targeted, messaging angle, and an estimated two-week timeline. • Proof of placement: screenshots of forum threads, any supporting social posts, and Discord messages so I can verify every mention. • A short report on traction — joins, comments, or inquiries generated — so I can gauge which hubs convert best. Required standards are simple: real members only, no mass DMs, no paid bot lists, and nothing that risks Discord TOS or the server's reputation. If you have prior success growing FiveM or similar RP servers, include a quick summary so I can see how your past approach maps to this project. Once I review the plan and green-light the outlets, you can start right away.

opportunities.title: Brand-Centric Logo Animation Needed
opportunities.description: I have an existing logo that I want to see come alive on screen, with the animation reinforcing the core personality of my brand rather than showing products or relying on flashy special-effects gimmicks. The style should feel clean, modern, and unmistakably “us”—think subtle motion, smart reveals, and timing that can sit comfortably at the start or end of any future video we publish. Here’s what I’m looking for: • A short, loop-ready animated version of the logo (3–6 seconds). • Final delivery in high-resolution MP4 or MOV plus a transparent-background render for overlay use. • Source file (After Effects, Blender, or similar) so we can make minor tweaks in-house later. When you respond, please focus on your experience creating brand-driven logo animations. A quick note on the tools you use and one or two links to past logo motion pieces that show a comparable style will help me gauge fit quickly. No need for a detailed project proposal at this stage—I’m primarily interested in seeing proven skill with identity-focused motion design. I’m ready to start as soon as I find the right animator and can turn feedback around promptly to keep the project moving.

opportunities.title: Optimización de Imagen para Impresión DTF
opportunities.description: Busco un diseñador con experiencia en preparación de imágenes para impresión DTF en poleras negras. El objetivo es limpiar y optimizar una ilustración proporcionada, conservando su diseño original y evitando fondos residuales, halos o bordes artificiales. Trabajo a realizar: - Limpiar la imagen y eliminar restos de fondo, píxeles aislados y bordes defectuosos. - Revisar las transparencias, sombras, colores y detalles para que el diseño se integre naturalmente con una polera negra. - Mantener las proporciones originales sin deformar ni rediseñar la ilustración. - Preparar 3 versiones en PNG, con fondo transparente real, resolución de 300 ppp y perfil de color sRGB, en estas medidas: - 33 × 49,5 cm. - 35 × 52,5 cm. - 36,33 × 54,5 cm. Entregables: 1. Los 3 archivos PNG listos para enviar al proveedor de impresión. 2. Archivo editable en PSD, organizado por capas cuando el material de origen lo permita. 3. Ficha técnica breve con las medidas, resolución, dimensiones en píxeles y perfil de color de cada archivo. Importante: No se debe eliminar automáticamente todo el color negro, ya que algunos detalles forman parte de la ilustración. Se busca un acabado limpio y profesional, sin alterar innecesariamente el diseño original. Antes de entregar, se comprobará que las medidas sean exactas, que la transparencia funcione correctamente y que no existan halos ni residuos de fondo. Busco una persona detallista, con experiencia en preparación de archivos para impresión y que pueda entregar los archivos correctamente organizados.

opportunities.title: Clonar Wix a WordPress Exacto (melaniagaliano.com)
opportunities.description: Quiero trasladar mi web melaniagaliano.com de Wix a WordPress conservando al 100 % su aspecto y estructura actual. Necesito que la réplica se construya con un maquetador visual; no tengo preferencia entre Elementor o Divi, así que puedes usar la herramienta que manejes mejor. Alcance del trabajo: • Estructura completa: El sitio web consta de 7 páginas estáticas principales (Inicio, Sobre mí, Yoga, Danza, Espectáculos, Contacto con formulario y galería de imágenes) y una sección de Blog. • Reproducción pixel-perfect de todas las páginas, incluyendo tipografías, colores, animaciones, imágenes y la disposición original. • Migración de contenidos: Importar de forma correcta todas las entradas existentes en el Blog actual de Wix hacia el nuevo WordPress. • SEO y Redirecciones 301: Configurar las redirecciones necesarias para mantener los enlaces del blog indexados en Google sin errores 404. • Diseño totalmente responsive (móvil/tablet) y optimizado para tiempos de carga rápidos. • Todos los contenidos deben quedar fácilmente editables desde el constructor visual, sin necesidad de tocar código. Entregables: 1. Sitio WordPress operativo y configurado en mi propio hosting (con el dominio apuntado correctamente al finalizar). 2. Archivo de exportación o copia de seguridad completa del sitio. 3. Guía breve (PDF o vídeo corto) con los pasos básicos para actualizar textos e imágenes en el futuro. Valoraré experiencia previa migrando de Wix a WordPress, atención al detalle y dominio de Elementor o Divi. Espero tu propuesta, presupuesto cerrado y ejemplos de trabajos similares. (Etiquetas: Elementor, Divi, WordPress, Wix, Migración Web, Diseño Web, SEO)

opportunities.description: Busco un editor de video para transformar un video en bruto en contenido dinámico y atractivo, con un estilo moderno y buen ritmo. Trabajo a realizar: - Editar el video principal con cortes precisos, ritmo fluido y música instrumental enérgica. - Añadir textos, gráficos sencillos y efectos cuando sean necesarios. - Mantener una narrativa clara y una edición visualmente atractiva. - Crear 3 Shorts verticales a partir de los mejores momentos del video, con cortes rápidos, textos destacados y música o efectos coherentes. Archivos del proyecto organizados en DaVinci Resolve, Premiere Pro u otro software de edición utilizado. opportunities.title: Optimización de Ilustración para Impresión DTF -- 2
opportunities.description: Busco un diseñador con experiencia en preparación de imágenes para impresión DTF en poleras negras. El objetivo es limpiar y optimizar una ilustración proporcionada, conservando su diseño original y evitando fondos residuales, halos o bordes artificiales. Trabajo a realizar: - Limpiar la imagen y eliminar restos de fondo, píxeles aislados y bordes defectuosos. - Revisar las transparencias, sombras, colores y detalles para que el diseño se integre naturalmente con una polera negra. - Mantener las proporciones originales sin deformar ni rediseñar la ilustración. - Preparar 3 versiones en PNG, con fondo transparente real, resolución de 300 ppp y perfil de color sRGB, en estas medidas: - 33 × 49,5 cm. - 35 × 52,5 cm. - 36,33 × 54,5 cm. Entregables: 1. Los 3 archivos PNG listos para enviar al proveedor de impresión. 2. Archivo editable en PSD, organizado por capas cuando el material de origen lo permita. 3. Ficha técnica breve con las medidas, resolución, dimensiones en píxeles y perfil de color de cada archivo. Importante: No se debe eliminar automáticamente todo el color negro, ya que algunos detalles forman parte de la ilustración. Se busca un acabado limpio y profesional, sin alterar innecesariamente el diseño original. Antes de entregar, se comprobará que las medidas sean exactas, que la transparencia funcione correctamente y que no existan halos ni residuos de fondo. Busco una persona detallista, con experiencia en preparación de archivos para impresión y que pueda entregar los archivos correctamente organizados.

opportunities.title: Preparación de Ilustración para Impresión DTF
opportunities.description: Busco un diseñador con experiencia en preparación de imágenes para impresión DTF en poleras negras. El objetivo es limpiar y optimizar una ilustración proporcionada, conservando su diseño original y evitando fondos residuales, halos o bordes artificiales. Trabajo a realizar: - Limpiar la imagen y eliminar restos de fondo, píxeles aislados y bordes defectuosos. - Revisar las transparencias, sombras, colores y detalles para que el diseño se integre naturalmente con una polera negra. - Mantener las proporciones originales sin deformar ni rediseñar la ilustración. - Preparar 3 versiones en PNG, con fondo transparente real, resolución de 300 ppp y perfil de color sRGB, en estas medidas: - 33 × 49,5 cm. - 35 × 52,5 cm. - 36,33 × 54,5 cm. Entregables: 1. Los 3 archivos PNG listos para enviar al proveedor de impresión. 2. Archivo editable en PSD, organizado por capas cuando el material de origen lo permita. 3. Ficha técnica breve con las medidas, resolución, dimensiones en píxeles y perfil de color de cada archivo. Importante: No se debe eliminar automáticamente todo el color negro, ya que algunos detalles forman parte de la ilustración. Se busca un acabado limpio y profesional, sin alterar innecesariamente el diseño original. Antes de entregar, se comprobará que las medidas sean exactas, que la transparencia funcione correctamente y que no existan halos ni residuos de fondo. Busco una persona detallista, con experiencia en preparación de archivos para impresión y que pueda entregar los archivos correctamente organizados.
